properties.name: HSWM ICE graph implementation WP0–3
properties.description: Source-bound local engineering snapshot for scope-preserving specialization and execution observations; it does not establish efficacy.

properties.name: WP0 versioned payload and Q1–Q6 contracts
properties.description: Versioned local payload and semantic fixtures provide bounded inspectability.

properties.name: WP1 parent eligibility and selector composition
properties.description: Bound child effective guard preserves mandatory parent guard plus selector.

properties.name: WP2 planning and leaf execution observation
properties.description: Candidate/selection/occurrence/output/cost slots and strict provider usage observation.

properties.name: WP3 co-eligible local alternatives fixture
properties.description: Two-route fixture and forced eligible route surface for feasibility/trace coverage.

properties.name: Bound parent scope contract
properties.description: Parent uid/revision/digest, mandatory guard, selector and effective guard are recomputed before child eligibility.

properties.name: Legacy unbound specialization withholding
properties.description: Legacy child history is preserved but withheld; it does not block a valid bound successor.

properties.name: Stale feedback meaning and scope withholding
properties.description: Outcome is retained but model update is withheld when selected meaning changes or parent scope becomes invalid.

properties.name: Exact occurrence and delivered-context observation boundary
properties.description: Occurrence records delivered context and pins selected/cell revisions plus input/output digests; actual source reads remain unknown or not instrumented.

properties.name: Leaf-only cost observation
properties.description: Leaf duration is summed once; router inclusive time is not added, missing human/money/retry cost remains null.

properties.name: Strict provider usage observation
properties.description: Only provider-reported nonnegative integer token totals with exact sum are recorded; missing or invalid usage is null/status.

properties.name: E1 local selection effect remains unidentified
properties.description: Fixture demonstrates co-eligibility and route forcing, not superior learned selection.

properties.name: E2 goal-level effect remains unidentified
properties.description: Question/read/action generation is not implemented in WP0–3; stage feedback and two outer routes are not prerequisites for this independent evaluation design.

properties.name: v1 learner semantics preserved
properties.description: Feature update and learner identity remain v1; WP4 versioned learner comparison is pending.

properties.name: WP4 learner v2 comparison
properties.description: Feature-count mitigation and version-aware learner comparison are not implemented.

properties.name: WP5 stage-feedback API
properties.description: Output-bound idempotent stage review API is not implemented.

properties.name: WP6 question/read/action revision
properties.description: Evidence-grounded question and resolver/action revision is not implemented.

properties.name: WP7 real-use efficacy evaluation
properties.description: Real-use quality, total cost and efficacy evaluation is not implemented.

properties.name: Bounded implementation verification
properties.description: Sanitized verification artifact records checks; it is not efficacy evidence.
